scope: District-linked public events, statements, demands, reported activities and documentary evidence from 2023–2026; supplemental to original 182-record Aug–Nov 2026 media archive
method: The district field denotes the constituency/subject or the public event location as reported. A parliamentary question or press statement does not prove physical presence or completed works. Verify supporting source. The actionType and outcomeStatus fields distinguish reported activity and parliamentary demands from verified delivery; no entry is treated as a completed project without separate proof. Supplements include dated third-party publisher reports; these are not independent confirmations of quoted claims or eventual delivery. An actionType identifies the nature of evidence, and outcomeStatus avoids inferring project completion.

records.title: Kondagaon campaign: Markam’s reported village outreach amid tribal concerns
records.summary: A November 2023 political profile reports Markam's constituency campaign and tribal grievances. Campaign activity is not evidence of completed public works.
records.outcomeStatus: Campaign reported; no completed work verified

records.title: Baij joins Hasdeo forest demonstration opposing Parsa coal mining
records.summary: Report describes Baij joining a protest at Hariharpur, Surguja, calling for protection of forest rights and opposing mining. Statements are attributed claims, not independently verified findings.
records.outcomeStatus: Advocacy reported; no government outcome verified

records.title: Korba MP report card: questions, MPLADS proposals and mining-displacement demands
records.summary: Report describes Jyotsna Mahant raising displacement/rehabilitation issues linked to SECL mines, railway and hospital requests, and proposed MPLADS works. Progress figures are a 2024 snapshot; proposals must not be read as completed projects.
records.outcomeStatus: Proposed works and claims; completion not independently verified

records.title: Netam raises proposal for multipurpose sports hall in Farsgaon, Kondagaon
records.summary: Official Rajya Sabha debate records her request for a multipurpose hall at Farsgaon in Kondagaon district and archery support for indigenous and tribal sports. This is a parliamentary demand, not a completed construction.
records.outcomeStatus: Facility requested; not evidence of construction

records.title: Baghel leads Durg demonstration after MLA Devendra Yadav’s arrest
records.summary: Published report says Baghel led a Congress protest in Durg demanding a probe into the Baloda Bazar case. Allegations voiced by political leaders remain allegations.
records.outcomeStatus: Protest reported; no policy outcome verified

records.title: Mahant leads Sakti protest as Congress demands inquiry into Baloda Bazar case
records.summary: Report identifies the Leader of the Opposition as leading the Congress protest in Sakti district. This is evidence of a reported public political event, not of development delivery.
records.verification: Published 25 Aug 2024, referring to 24 Aug demonstration
records.outcomeStatus: Protest reported; no inquiry outcome verified

records.title: Baij joins Raipur opposition protest over Baloda Bazar arrests
records.summary: Report says Congress president Baij led a public protest in Raipur. This is location of a public rally, not evidence of travel monitoring.
records.verification: Published 25 Aug 2024; public event reported for 24 Aug
records.outcomeStatus: Protest reported; no inquiry outcome verified

records.title: Baloda Bazar farmers approach MLA Sandeep Sahu about irrigation reservoir water
records.summary: NDTV MP-CG video reports local farmers asking Sandeep Sahu for irrigation supplies from Balar reservoir. It documents a request, not confirmed water allocation.
records.outcomeStatus: Irrigation request reported; allocation not verified

records.title: Patel questions Raigarh land acquisition and compensation figures in Assembly
records.summary: Report describes Patel challenging official figures and asking about land acquisition/compensation for National Highway 200 in Raigarh district. Legislative questions are not evidence of compensation paid.
records.outcomeStatus: Question reported; compensation outcome not verified

records.title: Deepak Baij completes Dantewada Nyay Padyatra opposing private iron-ore allotments
records.summary: PTI reports Baij leading the four-day Kirandul–Dantewada foot march, with Congress demanding cancellation of several private mine allotments. Claims about leases are party statements; march is reported to have occurred.
records.outcomeStatus: March reported; mining allocation decision not verified

records.title: Bhilai MLA meets constituents at Sector 5 office about local grievances
records.summary: Report describes a public constituency meeting at the MLA office in Bhilai where residents raised local concerns. No independent record of grievance resolution is included.
records.outcomeStatus: Meeting reported; grievance resolution not verified

records.title: Patel joins Kharsia villagers’ protest over deteriorated roads
records.summary: Amar Ujala documents Umesh Patel joining a road-condition protest with residents from villages in Kharsia. Report indicates officials were approached; the article headline claims demands met, which requires confirmation of completed road repairs.
records.outcomeStatus: Road advocacy reported; completed repairs not verified

records.title: Kharsia farmers protest fertiliser shortage under Umesh Patel’s leadership
records.summary: Local report describes a gherao of Kharsia tehsil office over fertiliser supply, led by Patel and Congress workers. This is reported collective action, not proof of supply restoration.
records.outcomeStatus: Farmer advocacy reported; final supply outcome not verified

records.title: Singh Deo disputes government account of delayed Ambikapur medical college hospital
records.summary: Singh Deo and state ministers traded accusations over the delayed hospital project. Singh Deo argued the government should account for its own time in office; this records a public policy response, not completed construction.
records.outcomeStatus: Concern raised; hospital completion not verified

records.title: Korba–Gevra passenger train and Korba pit line raised in Lok Sabha
records.summary: The Korba MP's parliamentary record lists a request to restart the Korba–Gevra Road passenger service and develop a pit line at Korba. This demonstrates advocacy; it does not confirm train restoration.
records.verification: PRS debate index, Lok Sabha, 29 Jul 2024
records.outcomeStatus: Rail service requested; delivery not established

records.title: Mahant requests improvements to Korba ESIC hospital
records.summary: Her Lok Sabha activity lists a special mention seeking improvement of healthcare facilities at ESIC Hospital in Korba. The parliamentary request does not establish that upgrades were completed.
records.verification: PRS debate index, Lok Sabha, 11 Feb 2025
records.outcomeStatus: Hospital improvement requested; completion unverified

records.title: Netam raises Kirandul flood damage and requests NMDC compensation
records.summary: The official Rajya Sabha synopsis records her appeal for an inquiry, adequate compensation for flood-affected families, and safer mining embankments following the Kirandul flood. It documents a legislative intervention, not completed assistance.
records.verification: Rajya Sabha synopsis, 31 Jul 2024, Special Mention 22, printed pp. 143–144. Parliamentary synopsis notes it is not an authoritative final verbatim record.
records.outcomeStatus: Inquiry and compensation requested; outcomes unverified

records.title: Netam raises Sirpur World Heritage recognition proposal for Mahasamund
records.summary: PRS lists a 29 July 2024 Rajya Sabha intervention calling for Sirpur's inclusion in the World Heritage framework. Sirpur is in Mahasamund district. This records the demand, not attribution for any later UNESCO listing.
records.verification: PRS Rajya Sabha debate index, 29 Jul 2024; geographical reference confirmed by Mahasamund District administration
records.outcomeStatus: Recognition requested in 2024; no subsequent outcome attributed to this intervention

records.title: Netam demands direct Delhi–Jagdalpur flights for Bastar connectivity
records.summary: The Rajya Sabha activity index records a request for direct air services between Delhi and Jagdalpur. Jagdalpur lies in Bastar district. The record is a demand and does not itself establish any operational service.
records.verification: PRS Rajya Sabha debate index, 2 Aug 2024
records.outcomeStatus: Direct flight service requested; operation not verified

records.title: Markam alleges irregularities in Kondagaon District Mineral Foundation works
records.summary: During a Chhattisgarh Assembly intervention, Markam alleged misuse of around ₹7 crore in Kondagaon DMF work and sought a probe. This is an attributed allegation, not a corruption finding.
records.verification: Indian Express published 14 Mar 2023; alleged Assembly intervention 13 Mar
records.outcomeStatus: Inquiry requested; alleged misuse not established by this source

records.title: Baghel participates in Patan cattle-management demonstration
records.summary: A local publisher reports Baghel and Congress workers protesting stray cattle, risks to traffic and crop damage in Patan, Durg. The article reports a public demonstration but not an independently verified long-term management result.
records.outcomeStatus: Stray-cattle management demanded; lasting remedial action not verified

records.title: Patan farmers ask Baghel to intervene in power-line construction and crop damage
records.summary: Local report describes farmers from Asoga and nearby villages meeting Baghel to seek relief over transmission-tower work affecting standing crops and asking that activity be paused until harvest.
records.outcomeStatus: Farmers' appeal documented; pause or compensation not verified

records.title: Bhilai MLA Yadav writes to collector over potential residential evictions
records.summary: Local report describes Devendra Yadav writing to the district collector about financially vulnerable families living in Bhilai Steel Plant accommodation and calling for action on threatened evictions.
records.outcomeStatus: Letter reported; eviction orders or safeguards not independently verified

records.title: Yadav hears Bhilai grievances on water, roads, drains, lighting and healthcare
records.summary: Bhilai Times reports a public meeting at the Sector 5 MLA office with residents discussing irregular water supply, broken roads, waterlogging, sanitation, street lighting and health access.
records.outcomeStatus: Complaints and reportedly issued instructions; completed remedial works not verified

records.title: Yadav meets Bhilai Steel Plant township officials about local facilities
records.summary: A local report describes a meeting with BSP township management about stray cattle, lease renewals and housing maintenance. The meeting should not be confused with delivered infrastructure.
records.outcomeStatus: Concerns raised with officials; resolution not established

records.title: Yadav urges electricity-supply attention during Bhilai resident meeting
records.summary: Bhilai Times reports a constituency visit where Yadav heard public concerns and instructed department officials to improve electric service arrangements.
records.outcomeStatus: Instructions reported; utility improvements not independently verified

records.title: Kasdol MLA Sahu raises lack of local jobs at Baloda Bazar cement plants
records.summary: Coverage of the Assembly's Question Hour attributes to Sandeep Sahu questions about employment opportunities for qualified residents despite local cement factories. Employment changes are not documented.
records.outcomeStatus: Employment concern raised; policy or hiring outcomes unverified

records.title: Charan Das Mahant calls for Sakti DMF funds to serve local development priorities
records.summary: Local coverage identifies Mahant at Sakti district mineral foundation trust governing council meeting and reports his call for DMF funds to benefit common residents. This does not establish a funded project's completion.
records.outcomeStatus: Development use of DMF requested; allocation and completion not established

records.title: Korba MP submits memorandum on SECL coal mine displacement to parliamentary committee
records.summary: Regional industrial newspaper reports that Jyotsna Charandas Mahant submitted a written memorandum at a Coal, Mines and Steel committee meeting calling attention to families displaced or affected by SECL coal mines in Korba district.
records.outcomeStatus: Memorandum reported; rehabilitation or compensation outcome unverified

records.title: Umesh Patel questions illegal fly-ash dumping and coal transport in Raigarh
records.summary: News agency reporting identifies Patel asking the state Assembly about fly-ash dumping, polluting coal transport, enforcement and industry numbers in Raigarh. The Congress walked out dissatisfied with the response; allegations and official replies are attributed.
records.verification: PTI published 27 Feb 2026; also covered by The Hitavada 28 Feb
records.outcomeStatus: Questions and official response recorded; environmental conditions not independently measured

records.title: Baij's Bastar mining memorandum also disputes Hahaladi iron-ore lease in Kanker
records.summary: PTI reports Baij's Dantewada Nyay Padyatra and an associated memorandum objecting to private mine allotments, specifically naming Hahaladi in Kanker district. This is district-subject evidence, not a claim that Baij travelled to Kanker.
records.verification: PTI 29 May 2025; Kanker location is referenced as subject of memorandum
records.outcomeStatus: Cancellation demanded; lease outcome not independently verified

records.title: NDTV profiles Singh Deo's reported contributions to Ambikapur medical college
records.summary: NDTV's video profile credits Singh Deo with contributions to medical facilities and health infrastructure in Ambikapur and rural Surguja. This is a broadcaster's attributed assessment, not independently verified attribution of construction or operating outcomes.
records.outcomeStatus: NDTV attributes healthcare initiatives; individual delivery claims require official completion records
